end.summary: Recognised halves, thirds and quarters as parts of equal-sized sections.
end.parentNote: Compared 1/2 and 1/3 by noticing that the same whole split into two parts gives larger pieces than when split into three. Practised finding fractions of collections using equal groups; the 1/3 of 12 example was not completed independently, while later equal-group examples used division. At home, share paper strips or fruit into 2, 3 and 4 equal parts and ask which single part is larger.
